title: Tôi cho anh/chị xem trên điện thoại được không?
englishTitle: Can I show it on my phone?
pronunciation: Toi cho anh chi xem tren dien thoai duoc khong
summary: For asking airport, hotel, or counter staff if a booking, QR code, ticket, or document can be shown digitally.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi cho anh/chị xem trên điện thoại được không? belongs in an airport counter, baggage area, or pickup point, with the passport, baggage tag, flight detail, or pickup screen close by.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the screen after asking; brightness up helps.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: The line asks permission before you push the phone forward.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi cho anh/chị xem trên điện thoại được không?
breakdown.english: Can I show it on my phone?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Useful if the exchange continues: Where is immigration, Where is baggage claim, and Where can I buy a SIM card.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it at immigration, check-in, baggage, pickup, or ticket counters when the proof is digital.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Ask first, then turn the screen around. It keeps the phone handoff polite and clear.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Good next-step cards: Where is the pickup area, Where do I meet the driver, and My bag did not arrive.
